title: Linear equations: balancing both sides
text: ALGEBRA — Linear equations. An equation stays balanced when the same operation is applied to both sides. Example: 3x + 5 = 20. Subtract 5: 3x = 15. Divide by 3: x = 5. Check by substitution.

title: Cell membranes and transport
text: BIOLOGY — Cell membrane. The phospholipid bilayer is selectively permeable. Diffusion moves particles down a concentration gradient. Osmosis is diffusion of water across a partially permeable membrane.

title: Balancing chemical equations
text: CHEMISTRY — Conservation of mass. Atoms are conserved in a chemical reaction. Balance coefficients rather than changing subscripts. 2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O.

title: Python loops and list iteration
text: COMPUTER SCIENCE — for item in items: print(item). A for loop visits each element in an iterable. A while loop repeats while its condition is True. Watch for off-by-one errors in range().

title: Newton's second law in practice
text: PHYSICS — F = ma. Net force equals mass multiplied by acceleration. SI units: force in newtons, mass in kilograms, acceleration in metres per second squared.

title: The causes of the French Revolution
text: HISTORY — 1789. Social inequality among the three estates, financial crisis and state debt, poor harvests, and Enlightenment ideas about popular sovereignty contributed to the revolution.

title: Building a clear thesis statement
text: WRITING — A strong thesis makes a specific, arguable claim and previews the reasoning. Avoid a topic-only statement. Support the argument with evidence.

title: Quadratic graphs and the vertex
text: ALGEBRA — For y = a(x - h)^2 + k, the vertex is (h, k) and the axis of symmetry is x = h. The sign of a controls whether a parabola opens up or down.

title: DNA genes and inheritance
text: BIOLOGY — DNA stores inherited information. A gene is a section of DNA. Alleles are alternative forms of a gene. Genotype describes alleles; phenotype describes observable traits.

title: Sorting algorithm comparison
text: COMPUTER SCIENCE — Bubble sort swaps adjacent values and has average time complexity O(n^2). Merge sort splits and merges; it runs in O(n log n) time with O(n) extra space.

title: Energy conservation and pendulums
text: PHYSICS — At the top of a swing, gravitational potential energy is greatest. As the pendulum descends, energy transfers into kinetic energy. Friction transfers energy to heat.

title: Sources and evidence in history essays
text: HISTORY + WRITING — Use provenance, context, and corroboration to assess a primary source. In an essay, make a claim, support it with evidence, and explain how the evidence answers the question.

title: Acids bases and pH
text: CHEMISTRY — The pH scale indicates acidity. A solution with pH below 7 is acidic; above 7 is basic. Neutralisation between an acid and a base can form salt and water.

title: Short scratch note
text: F = ma. Check units.

title: Code lab parsing CSV rows
text: import csv. A DictReader parses CSV rows into keyed values. A parser handles quoted fields more reliably than splitting a line on commas.

title: Photosynthesis overview
text: BIOLOGY — Chlorophyll in chloroplasts captures light energy. Carbon dioxide and water are converted into glucose and oxygen. 6CO2 + 6H2O -> C6H12O6 + 6O2.

title: Solving a system by substitution
text: ALGEBRA — Solve the equation y = 2x + 1 together with x + y = 10. Substitute the expression for y, solve for x, then substitute back to find y.

title: Cellular respiration
text: BIOLOGY — Cells release energy from glucose through cellular respiration. Mitochondria are a key site of aerobic respiration; oxygen is used and carbon dioxide is produced.

title: Ionic and covalent bonding
text: CHEMISTRY — Ionic bonding involves electron transfer and electrostatic attraction between ions. Covalent bonding involves shared pairs of electrons between atoms.

title: Function parameters in Python
text: COMPUTER SCIENCE — A function groups reusable instructions. Parameters receive values; return sends a result to the caller. def square(n): return n * n.

title: Velocity time graphs
text: PHYSICS — The gradient of a velocity-time graph represents acceleration. The area beneath the graph represents displacement. Include units on both axes.

title: Primary and secondary sources
text: HISTORY — A primary source comes from the period being studied; a secondary source interprets or analyses it later. Consider author, purpose, context, and intended audience.

title: Paragraph structure for a persuasive essay
text: WRITING — A focused paragraph can present a claim, evidence, and reasoning. Link each paragraph to the thesis and use transitions to guide the reader.

title: Noisy terminology scratchpad
text: Δx = v₀t + ½at². Units: m, m/s, m/s². Verify assumptions before using the kinematics equation.

title: Debugging an index error
text: COMPUTER SCIENCE — Python lists use zero-based indexing. IndexError often means an index is outside the valid range. Check the loop boundary and the length of the list.

title: The water cycle and ecosystems
text: BIOLOGY — Evaporation, condensation, and precipitation move water through ecosystems. Organisms depend on this cycle; environmental conditions affect habitats.

title: Moles and molar mass
text: CHEMISTRY — The mole links particle count to amount of substance. Calculate moles using n = m/M, where m is mass and M is molar mass in grams per mole.

title: Interpreting a historical claim
text: HISTORY — Compare accounts of an event, corroborate evidence, and distinguish a source's claim from what the evidence supports. Chronology helps establish context.
